title: Atlas billing and plan settings
audience: A workspace owner reviewing plan cost and billing details
scenario: Atlas is a static account settings view for a fictional 24-seat team on a monthly Pro plan.
task: Build a billing settings page that clarifies current plan, next charge, payment method, invoices, and the consequences of plan changes.

sections: Settings navigation with Profile, Workspace, Members, Billing & plan, Integrations, and Security
Current Pro plan at $18 per seat monthly for 24 seats
Plan actions Change plan and Cancel plan
Invoice history for July, June, and May 2026 with date, amount, and Paid status
Billing contact billing@example.test and tax information status Not provided

requirements: Expose Billing & plan as the selected settings section
Associate cost with cadence and seat count
Use a semantic table for invoice history
Separate routine plan changes from the destructive cancellation path
Describe that controls are static and no billing action will occur
constraints: Do not implement downloads, payment changes, plan changes, or cancellation
Do not display a complete payment card number
Do not add discounts, taxes, credits, or annual-plan claims
Do not use remote assets or services
evaluation_focus: Clarity of financial details and billing cadence
Safe treatment of destructive and non-functional actions
